evidence: pkg/server/module_server_test.go:35-38 unconditionally skips TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer for every postgres run, so local postgres runs lose coverage too, even though the skip message says it 'Works locally'. Coverage loss is real, but the scope is one integration test, the skip carries a TODO, and sqlite is already skipped the same way at line 33. Gating on a CI env var (e.g. DRONE) would keep local coverage, but it's a nice-to-have rather than a defect.

pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:100 only turns an existing TODO from an Info log line (b.log.Info("TODO, check last RV...")) into a comment. The TODO was already there before this PR, so nothing new gets lost. The resourceVersion parameter doc at bleve.go:80 already describes the intended optimization. Filing a tracking issue is a process choice and needs no code change.

BuildIndex no longer holds cacheMu for the whole build. The lock is now taken only around the cache write (pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:137-139). getOrCreateIndex (resource/search.go:287-305) does a check-then-build: GetIndex takes an RLock and releases it, then build runs with no per-key guard. Two concurrent gRPC Search calls (search.go:148/160) for a namespace/resource with no index yet (e.g. below initMinSize, or new) can both miss the cache and build the same index at the same time; the last write wins and the other index is thrown away. The same check-then-build gap existed before (GetIndex was never under the build lock), but builds used to run one at a time, and the in-code TODO at search.go:288-290 already notes that per-key blocking is needed. Impact is wasted work rather than corruption: getOrCreateIndex passes size=10, so these builds are memory-only and bleve.New never races on the same directory. init builds distinct keys taken from GetResourceStats and now finishes before serving/watch starts, so the startup path is not affected. A singleflight keyed on NamespacedResource would be a cheap fix.

This is a generic tool threshold, not a finding about this diff. The PR adds no new functions or exported symbols; it only edits bodies in server.go, search.go, bleve.go and backend.go. The touched functions already carry doc comments where Go convention calls for them, e.g. search.go:171 '// init is called during startup...', server.go '// History implements ResourceServer.', backend.go:125 '// GetResourceStats implements Backend.', bleve.go:143 '// TotalDocs returns...'. Grafana has no 80% docstring coverage requirement.
